05 / ABOUT ME

Creativity in practice.
Curiosity in everything.

A background in design and media.
A future shaped by technology.

I'm Mohamed Mohamed Hussein, a graphic designer, social media professional and Computer Science student at Kuala Lumpur University of Science and Technology. With more than three years of graphic design experience, I connect visual communication with a growing focus on data science.

My experience spans teaching graphic design at Sahal Institute of Computer and Information Technology, camera work for New Ways Organizations and Merca District Football Association, and volunteering with Gargaar Relief Development Organisation (GREDO). These roles have brought me into education, business, sports and community work.

Today, I work in graphic design and social media management at Tech Grow Training and Innovation Center, and manage social media for Sahal Institute. At university, I serve as Social Media Officer for SSA-KLUST and contribute to multimedia and social media management at KLUST – Cyber Alliance.

Alongside my creative work, I use Python, SQL, Excel and Power BI in my learning and projects. My portfolio brings together this wider journey: design, media, analytics, programming, databases and the people behind the work.
